spans.s: यज् vi. or vt. 1U (pp. इष्ट; pres. यजति-ते; pass. इज्यते; desid. यियक्षति-ते) 1. To sacrifice, M.xi.40; (often used with the instrumental of the word signifying ‘rite, sacrifice,’ इष्ट्वा च शक्तितो यज्ञैः M.vi.36); 2. to make an oblation to a particular deity, (with acc. of the deity and inst. of the oblation, वाग्दैवत्यैश्च चरुभिर्यजेरंस्ते सरस्वतीम् M.viii.105); 3. to worship.With सम्-, to worship, समयष्टास्रमंडलम् Bt.xv.96.

यजति m. A term for those sacrifices to which the verb यजति is applied, as distinguished from those rites to which the verb जुहोति applies. (See M.ii.84 and Medhātithi thereon; Sarvajnyanārāyaṇa renders जुहोति by उपविष्टहोम and यजति by तिष्ठद्धोम.)
यजत्र (I) m. A Brāhmaṇa maintaining consecrated fire.
यजत्र (II) n. The maintenance of such fire.
यजन n. 1. The act of sacrificing; 2. a sacrifice; 3. a place of sacrifice.
याजन n. The act of performing a sacrifice, M.i.88.
यजमान m. 1. A person who institutes a regular sacrifice and pays its expenses; 2. one who employs priests to perform a sacrifice for his behoof; 3. a patron, a rich man, a host.
यजमान-शिष्य m. a pupil of a Brāhmaṇa who performs a sacrifice, ततः प्रविशति कुशानुनादाय यजमानशिष्यः Sak.iii.
यजि m. 1. A sacrificer; 2. a sacrifice, दानमध्ययनं यजिः M.x.79.
यजुस् n. A sacred mantra in prose, a text of the Yajurveda.
यजुर्वेद m. the second of the three principal Vedas consisting of sacred texts in prose and relating to sacrifices. It is two-fold, viz., तैत्तिरीय or शुक्लयजुर्वेद and वाजसनेय or कृष्णयजुर्वेद.

यज्ञ m. 1. A sacrifice, R.i.26, Bg.ix.20; 2. any devotional act generally; (the five daily acts of devotion enjoined to a Brāhmaṇa are- भूतयज्ञ, मनुष्ययज्ञ, पितृयज्ञ, देवयज्ञ and ब्रह्मयज्ञ; they are collectively called the five ‘great sacrifices’; See महायज्ञ); 3. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-अंश m. a share of a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-अंश˚भुज् m. a deity, यज्ञांशभुजामिदानीम् K.S.iii.14.
यज्ञ-अगार, -आगार m.n. a sacrificial hall.
यज्ञ-अगार, -आगार m.n. a sacrificial hall.
यज्ञ-अंग (I) m. the Udumbara tree.
यज्ञ-अंग (II) n. 1. a part of a sacrifice; 2. a means or instrument of a sacrifice, यज्ञांगयोनित्वमवेक्ष्य यस्य K.S.i.17.
यज्ञ-आत्मन्, -ईश्वर m. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-आत्मन्, -ईश्वर m. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-उपकरण n. any utensil or implement necessary for a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-उपवीत n. the sacred thread usually worn by the twice-born over the left shoulder and under the right arm (See M.ii.63), वामांसावलंबिना यज्ञोपवीतेनोद्भासमानः Kad.
यज्ञ-कर्मन् (I) a. engaged in a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-कर्मन् (II) n. a sacrificial rite.
यज्ञ-कल्प a. of the nature of a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-कीलक m. the post to which the victim is fastened at a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-कुंड n. a hole in the ground built for receiving the sacrificial fire.
यज्ञ-क्रतु m. 1. a complete rite, a chief ceremony; 2. on epithet of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-घ्न m. a demon interrupting sacrifices.
यज्ञ-दक्षिणा f. the fee given to a priest engaged in a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-दीक्षा f. 1. admission to a sacrificial rite; 2. performance of a sacrifice, M.ii.169.
यज्ञ-द्रव्य n. anything used for a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-पति m. 1. one who institutes a sacrifice; 2. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-पशु m. 1. an animal for sacrifice; 2. a horse.
यज्ञ-पुरुष m. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्ञ-भाग m. 1. a portion of a sacrifice, a portion of the oblation offered, K.S.i.17; 2. a god, a deity.
यज्ञ-भुज् m. a deity.
यज्ञ-भूमि f. a place where sacrifices are performed.
यज्ञ-वराह m. Viṣṇu in his boar-incarnation.
यज्ञ-वल्लि, -वल्ली f. the Soma plant.
यज्ञ-वल्लि, -वल्ली f. the Soma plant.
यज्ञ-वाट m. a place prepared and inclosed for a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-वृक्ष m. the Indian fig tree.
यज्ञ-वेदि, -वेदी f. a sacrificial altar.
यज्ञ-वेदि, -वेदी f. a sacrificial altar.
यज्ञ-शरण n. a building or a temporary structure under which a sacrifice is performed.
यज्ञ-शाला f. a sacrificial hall.
यज्ञ-शेष m.n. the remains of a sacrifice, यज्ञशेषं तथामृतम् M.iii.285.
यज्ञ-श्रेष्ठा f. the Soma plant.
यज्ञ-सदस् n. an assembly of people at a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-संभार m. materials for a sacrifice.
यज्ञ-सिद्धि f. the completion of a sacrificial ceremony.
यज्ञ-सूत्र n. the same as यज्ञोपवीत q.v.
यज्ञ-सेन m. an epithet of king Drupada.
यज्ञ-स्थाणु m. deprived of power, fallen from office.
यज्ञ-हन्, -हन m. an epithet of Śiva.
यज्ञ-हन्, -हन m. an epithet of Śiva.
यज्ञिक m. The Palāśa tree.
याज्ञिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a sacrifice.
याज्ञिक (II) m. A sacrificer, a sacrificing priest.
यज्ञिय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Sacred, holy; 2. relating to or suitable for a sacrifice, sacrificial; 3. pious.
यज्ञिय (II) m. 1. A god, a deity; 2. the third or Dvāpara age of the Hindus.
यज्ञिय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Sacred, holy; 2. relating to or suitable for a sacrifice, sacrificial; 3. pious.
यज्ञीय a. (f. या) Sacrificial.
यज्ञीय a. (f. या) Sacrificial.
यज्ञिय-देश m. region fit for sacrifices, a particular part of India thus defined by Manu- कृष्णसारस्तु चरति मृगो यत्र स्वभावतः । स ज्ञेयो यज्ञियो देशः ii.23.
यज्ञिय-शाला f. a sacrificial hall.
यज्ञीय-ब्रह्मपादप m. the Vikankata tree.
यज्वन् (I) a. (f. ज्वरी) Sacrificing, worshipping.
यज्वन् (II) m. 1. One who performs sacrifices agreeably to the ritual of the Vedas, ग्रामेष्वात्मविसृष्टेषु यूपचिह्नेषु R.i.44, K.S.ii.46; 2. a name of Viṣṇu.
यज्वन् (I) a. (f. ज्वरी) Sacrificing, worshipping.
याजक m. 1. A sacrificer, a sacrificing priest; 2. a royal elephant, an elephant in rut.
याज्ञसेनी f. A patronymic of Draupadī, Ve.i.
याज्ञिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a sacrifice.
याज्य (I) a. (f. ज्या) 1. One for whom a sacrifice is performed; 2. one privileged to sacrifice, R.i.86; 3. to be sacrificed, sacrificial.
याज्य (II) m. A sacrificer.
याज्य (III) n. The presents obtained by an officiating priest at a sacrifice.
याज्य (I) a. (f. ज्या) 1. One for whom a sacrifice is performed; 2. one privileged to sacrifice, R.i.86; 3. to be sacrificed, sacrificial.
